# pve_node_network (Resource)

Node network interface. Create, update, and delete record a pending change on the node; PVE activates pending changes only when they are applied. Commit them once per node with the pve_node_network_apply action, or set apply_on_change to apply after this interface's create or update. Destroy never applies; pve_node_network_rollback discards pending changes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_network" "example" {
  iface = "CHANGE_ME"
  node  = "pve1"
  type  = "bridge"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `iface` (String) Network interface name.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `type` (String) Network interface type One of: `bridge`, `bond`, `eth`, `alias`, `vlan`, `fabric`, `OVSBridge`, `OVSBond`, `OVSPort`, `OVSIntPort`, `vnet`, `unknown`.

### Optional

- `address` (String) IP address.
- `address6` (String) IP address.
- `apply_on_change` (Boolean) Apply the node's pending network changes (PUT /nodes/{node}/network) after this interface is created or updated. This commits every pending change on the node, not only this interface's. Unset or false: the change stays pending until the pve_node_network_apply action runs. Destroy never applies. Provider-side setting; never sent to PVE.
- `autostart` (Boolean) Automatically start interface on boot.
- `bond_mode` (String) Bonding mode. One of: `balance-rr`, `active-backup`, `balance-xor`, `broadcast`, `802.3ad`, `balance-tlb`, `balance-alb`, `balance-slb`, `lacp-balance-slb`, `lacp-balance-tcp`.
- `bond_primary` (String) Specify the primary interface for active-backup bond.
- `bond_xmit_hash_policy` (String) Selects the transmit hash policy to use for slave selection in balance-xor and 802.3ad modes. One of: `layer2`, `layer2+3`, `layer3+4`.
- `bridge_ports` (String) Specify the interfaces you want to add to your bridge.
- `bridge_vids` (String) Specify the allowed VLANs. For example: '2 4 100-200'. Only used if the bridge is VLAN aware.
- `bridge_vlan_aware` (Boolean) Enable bridge vlan support.
- `cidr` (String) IPv4 CIDR.
- `cidr6` (String) IPv6 CIDR.
- `comments` (String) Comments
- `comments6` (String) Comments
- `delete` (String) A list of settings you want to delete.
- `gateway` (String) Default gateway address.
- `gateway6` (String) Default ipv6 gateway address.
- `mtu` (Number) MTU.
- `netmask` (String) Network mask.
- `netmask6` (Number) Network mask.
- `ovs_bonds` (String) Specify the interfaces used by the bonding device.
- `ovs_bridge` (String) The OVS bridge associated with a OVS port. This is required when you create an OVS port.
- `ovs_options` (String) OVS interface options.
- `ovs_ports` (String) Specify the interfaces you want to add to your bridge.
- `ovs_tag` (Number) Specify a VLan tag (used by OVSPort, OVSIntPort, OVSBond)
- `slaves` (String) Specify the interfaces used by the bonding device.
- `vlan_id` (Number) vlan-id for a custom named vlan interface (ifupdown2 only).
- `vlan_raw_device` (String) Specify the raw interface for the vlan interface.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/iface (also the `terraform import` format).
- `method` (String) The network configuration method for IPv4. PVE sets `static` when `cidr` or `address` is sent, `manual` otherwise.
- `method6` (String) The network configuration method for IPv6. PVE sets `static` when `cidr6` or `address6` is sent, `manual` otherwise.
